pieces.name: King
pieces.description: Moves one square in any direction. Lose all your royal pieces and you lose.

pieces.name: Queen
pieces.description: Slides any distance in any direction.

pieces.name: 2009 Toyota Corolla
pieces.description: Moves like a Rook. Or CHARGE 🚗💨: drive any distance in a straight line (up, down, left or right) right through other pieces, running over every piece it passes and the one it lands on: friend or foe, the enemy King included. It can't charge through your own King. After a charge it can only make normal Rook moves for your next 3 turns (the badge counts down). If a piece survives being hit, the car drives over it; if the piece on the final square survives, the car stops on the last empty square before it.

pieces.name: Wizard
pieces.description: Each turn, pick one: STEP 1 square in any direction, capturing an enemy there. FIREBALL 🔥: blast the first piece within 3 squares in any of the 8 directions, friend or foe (never your own King), destroying it while the Wizard stays put. TELEPORT ✨: jump to any empty square, or swap places with one of your own pieces (never onto an enemy). Fireball and Teleport each have their own cooldown: after use, that ability is unavailable for your next 3 turns (the badge shows 🔥/✨ and turns left).

pieces.name: Knight
pieces.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Knight (jumps in an L shape, over anything in the way). Secretly a Kamikaze-Knight! On your turn, instead of moving, select it and click it again to Self-destruct 💥: it and every piece in the 3×3 square around it are destroyed, friend or foe, Kings included. (If both Kings go, it's a draw.) Being captured does not set it off.

pieces.name: Pawn
pieces.description: Moves 1 forward (2 on its first move) and captures diagonally forward. Becomes a Queen on the far rank.

pieces.name: Pawn
pieces.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a Wizard! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a Wizard (step, fireball and teleport, both ready to use). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.

pieces.name: Pawn
pieces.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a Kamikaze-Knight! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a Kamikaze-Knight (knight jumps and self-destruct). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.

pieces.name: Pawn
pieces.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a 2009 Toyota Corolla! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a 2009 Toyota Corolla (rook moves and charge, ready to use). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.
